title: H4598 (122nd General Assembly): Concealed weapons permit

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, South Carolina); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official South Carolina text (Introduced, 2018-01-10; official copy, https://www.scstatehouse.gov/sess122_2017-2018/prever/4598_20180110.htm (LegiScan doc 1679814))
provenance.note: Introduced version (Jan. 10, 2018); no later version or vote on file.

operative_text:
Section 1 (new Section 23-31-232): Notwithstanding another provision of law, upon express permission given by the appropriate church official or governing body, a person who holds a permit issued pursuant to this article may carry a concealable weapon on school premises when a church leases the school premises for church services or official church activities.
Section 1 (new Section 23-31-232): The provisions contained in this section only apply during those times that the church has the use and enjoyment of the property pursuant to its lease with the school.
